title: Cottage rental receipt
content: The rental receipt lists Seabird Cottage in Newport. The receipt is dated July 1986.

metadata.uncertainty: receipt date does not establish that all recollections describe one outing

title: Lisa coast recollection
content: I remember joining Sarah and Michael on the coast. We played in the sand by Seabird Cottage.

title: Sarah birthday picnic
content: My birthday picnic in Denver was in 1990. Michael brought cherry cake.

title: Michael's cousin
content: Lisa is my cousin. I remember Lisa joining us on the Oregon coast.
